title.zh: 找规律 · 不画也能报出第 100 个
title.en: Patterns · Name the 100th Without Drawing It

desc.zh: 用火柴棒摆图形：数出前几个，找到“每次多几根”，就能直接算出任意第 n 个。
desc.en: Build shapes from matchsticks: count the first few, find how many are added each time, then compute any figure n directly.
